context.stage: BO initiative origination for full development workflow

task.description: Submit a Meridian BO feature initiative in business language for a fully complete tenant registration process including tenant object visibility, OIDC authority readiness, and guaranteed tenant schema table materialization before completion.
acceptance_criteria: Initiative clearly states expected end-to-end behavior
Result status is PASS or FAIL with issues
next_action explicitly requests routing to WF-01 (REQ-ANALYST)

result.summary: Meridian BO initiative approved: Tenant onboarding is complete only when the tenant is visible in the platform operating model, identity authority is fully operational for secure sign-in, and all tenant-specific schema tables are materialized before go-live handover. This prevents disbursement workflows from starting on partially provisioned legal entities and protects auditability under regulated operating standards.

initiative.title: End-to-End Tenant Registration Completion Standard
initiative.business_outcome: A newly onboarded Meridian tenant can be activated for regulated lending operations without manual repair steps or post-activation data risk.
measurable_acceptance_criteria: Within one onboarding run, the tenant record is discoverable in tenant listings and detail views before completion is reported.
OIDC readiness is confirmed by successful authority metadata resolution and token issuance for the tenant before completion is reported.
Tenant schema materialization is complete before completion is reported, with zero missing required tenant tables at activation time.
If any one of visibility, OIDC readiness, or schema materialization fails, onboarding status is marked failed and no completion event is emitted.
initiative.regulatory_rationale: For a BaFin-regulated lender, incomplete tenant activation introduces control gaps in access governance, evidence traceability, and operational integrity. Completion must therefore represent a legally and operationally usable state, not a partial technical state.
